title: Hunt cycles can search and read the public web
description: Saved hunts find nothing today: a cycle runs Codex with workspace-write, which turns network access and web search off, and headless Claude refuses WebSearch and WebFetch unless they are allowed. Add StartOptions.web (default false). With it, the Codex adapter adds --config sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=true and --config web_search="live", and the Claude adapter adds WebSearch and WebFetch to --allowed-tools next to any tools already allowed. A flow cycle starts its adapter with web on only when a hunt is due in it, so other cycles and every ledger run stay offline. The fake vendor writes web.json in its folder so the probe can see what a cycle was started with.
acceptance: Codex argv has no network access or web search by default, and both with web on
Claude argv allows WebSearch and WebFetch only with web on, keeping tools already allowed
A cycle that runs a hunt starts its adapter with web on; a cycle with no hunt due keeps it off
